subject: Kickoff: Model Swarms expert adaptation
body:
Hi Bao,

Kicking off Model Swarms (Mar 23 – Jun 22). The method from our open-source release: treat a pool of LLM experts as particles in a swarm search and collaboratively adapt them to a target task — no gradient training, just utility-guided search that tracks a global best. The release ships a starter pipeline on the NLGraph graph-reasoning dataset, which is conveniently on-portfolio for us.

Product thesis: retrieval customers keep asking for domain-adapted experts without the cost and data-governance overhead of fine-tuning. If swarm search gets us 80% of fine-tuning quality at a fraction of the compute, that's a service.

Milestones: mid-April — NLGraph reproduction with the released search scripts; late May — swarm search on two internal retrieval tasks; mid-June — final validation sweep and a go/no-go for a Q3 service beta.

Staffing, compute, and the data-migration picture by Apr 10, please.

Anders
